context: A boss and his manager dissect a global-news column
purpose: Teach: 襲わ/サミット/襲撃/欠席/尊厳/盗難/扶助/濃厚

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: この記事、サミットでの襲撃事件報道、衝撃だな。
lines.en: This article's reporting on the summit attack—it's striking, isn't it.
lines.style: Measured, genuine surprise threaded through. Slight pause before the dash. Not performative, but genuinely struck. The tone of someone reading carefully and thinking aloud.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市民が襲われない安全網と、扶助の仕組み、両方議論されています。
lines.en: Yes. The piece covers both protecting citizens and the systems to support them.
lines.style: Quiet attentiveness. Respectful of his attention. Clear, precise—the tone of someone who's read carefully and is offering the right summary. No overreach.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 盗難事案も濃厚に絡む構造。
lines.en: And theft cases wind through the whole structure.
lines.style: Deliberate, analytical. Slight lean forward in the voice. Connecting dots aloud. Respect for the complexity—not oversimplifying, but not elaborate either.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 尊厳を守る視点、欠席率の改善まで含んだ広い議論です。
lines.en: Right. It's broad—goes from dignity and safeguards all the way through to attendance rates.
lines.style: Warm confirmation. Breathing ease into it. The tone of someone building on an idea together, not lecturing. Slight appreciative emphasis on the scope.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来月の経営会議で扱おう。
lines.en: We'll bring it to next month's management meeting.
lines.style: Quiet decision. No drama. The finality of someone who's made up his mind and is moving forward. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Respectful close. Calm, committed. The tone of someone who's heard and will act. Brief because it doesn't need to be anything else.
